author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
What is the best agent harness for LLM?
My fully AI-native jr. engineer.   I can just "prompt" him/her, then he/she baby sit the real harness for Claude/GPT, verify everything works properly before reporting back to me.
At the same time, there are some other engineers (jr. or sr.) makes me wonder why I am wasting my time talking to him/her instead just talking to AI directly myself.
